title: chat/message/tool
description: One tool call executed by the assistant during a reply, pushed to the UI.

session_id.description: Conversation session this tool call belongs to (scopes events to the owning window).

message_id.description: Id of the assistant reply this tool call belongs to.

seq.description: Monotonic tool-call sequence within the message (0-based).

ok.description: true when the tool executed successfully.

result.description: JSON-encoded tool result; when ok=false this is the error message.
